content: The CanTp module shall support optional primitives (proposed in ISO 15765 - 2 specification) for the dynamic setting of some transport protoc ol internal parameters (STmin and BS) by application. The BS value is only a maximum value. For reasons of buffer length, the CAN Transport Layer can adapt the BS value within the limit of the configured maximum value.
